title: Abstract Compression of Conversational Audio Context for LLM-based ASR
abstract: arXiv:2603.26246v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Standard LLM-based speech recognition systems process utterances in isolation, limiting their ability to leverage conversational context. Here we study whether multimodal context from prior turns improves LLM-based ASR and how to represent that context efficiently. We find that, after supervised multi-turn training, conversational context mainly helps with the recognition of contextual entities. However, conditioning on raw context is expensive because the prior-turn audio embedding sequence grows rapidly with conversation length. To address this, we propose Abstract Compression, a learned latent abstraction of prior-turn audio that replaces each prior-turn audio sequence with a fixed number of latent tokens while retaining corresponding transcripts explicitly. On both in-domain and out-of-domain test sets, the compression-enabled model recovers part of the gains of raw-context conditioning with a smaller prior-turn audio footp

translated_title: 面向基于大语言模型语音识别的对话音频上下文抽象压缩
translated_abstract: 标准的基于大语言模型（LLM）的语音识别系统孤立地处理每个话语，限制了其利用对话上下文的能力。本文研究了来自先前对话轮次的多模态上下文能否改进基于LLM的语音识别（ASR），以及如何高效地表示这些上下文。我们发现，经过监督多轮训练后，对话上下文主要有助于上下文相关实体的识别。然而，以原始上下文为条件的开销很大，因为先前轮次的音频嵌入序列会随对话长度的增长而迅速膨胀。为解决这一问题，我们提出了抽象压缩（Abstract Compression），这是一种对先前轮次音频的学习式潜在抽象，用固定数量的潜在标记替换每个先前轮次的音频序列，同时显式保留相应的转录文本。在域内和域外测试集上，启用压缩的模型以更小的先前轮次音频开销，恢复了原始上下文条件化所带来的一部分收益。
tldr: 提出抽象压缩方法，将对话历史音频压缩为固定数量的潜在标记并保留转录文本，使基于LLM的语音识别以更小开销提升上下文实体的识别效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes Abstract Compression, which compresses prior-turn conversational audio into a fixed number of latent tokens while retaining transcripts, enabling LLM-based ASR to improve contextual entity recognition at much lower context cost.
